TreeOfLife.description:
The Tree of Life: the ten sephirot (eleven with Da'at) coloured in either
scale and labelled from their magick-data rows, and the twenty-two paths
with their Hebrew letters. Each sphere and path is a link, by default to
a root-relative path (`/kabbalah/sephirah/<id>`, `/kabbalah/path/<id>`),
which `sephirahHref` and `pathHref` change or remove. It reads the data
itself and needs no client code, so it renders as a Server Component.
Its ids come from `useId` when `id` is not given; given a `ref`, a click
on a link in the browser sets `location.href`.

props.name: active
props.description: A sephirah's id: that sphere is drawn and the others faded.

props.name: activePath
props.description: A path's id (`"1_2"`): it is drawn on top and highlighted, the rest faded.

props.name: bottomText
props.description: The field path(s) set on an arc below each sphere's label.

props.name: colorScale
props.description: The scale the spheres are coloured in; the Queen's when not given.

props.name: field
props.description:
What each sphere is labelled with: a field path into its magick-data
row (`name.he`, `planet.name.en.en`, `stones.*.name.en`), or several
joined by commas, which are drawn space-separated. `index`, the
sphere's number, when not given.

props.name: flip
props.description: Seen from behind, the body's view; the stylesheet mirrors the figure.

props.name: fontBaseUrl
props.description:
Where Noto Sans and Noto Sans Hebrew are served, as
`NotoSans-Regular.ttf` and `NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf` under it. Given
one, the SVG carries `@font-face` rules for them, which an exported SVG
needs; the rules name the families for the whole page, as any
`@font-face` does. Without it the Tree only names the families, and
the page supplies them (or falls back to Arial and sans-serif).

props.name: fontSize
props.description: The labels' font size; from `field` when not given.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the figure's shape when not given.

props.name: id
props.description:
The `<svg>`'s id, which its stylesheet is scoped to and every id
inside it begins with (`<id>-paths`, `<id>-topTextPath0`): letters,
digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter. One from `useId` when
not given, so that several Trees can share a page.

props.name: labels
props.description: Each sphere's label, Keter first and Da'at eleventh, in place of `field`'s.

props.name: letterAttr
props.description: Whose letters the paths carry.

props.name: pathHref
props.description: A path's link, or `null` for none; `/kabbalah/path/<id>` by default.

props.name: sephirahHref
props.description: A sphere's link, or `null` for none; `/kabbalah/sephirah/<id>` by default.

props.name: showDaat
props.description:
Draws Da'at. Only the Queen scale colours it, so the King scale leaves
it out.

props.name: topText
props.description: The field path(s) set on an arc above each sphere's label.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; the container's, `"100%"`, when not given.

GradeTree.description:
The Tree of Life as the map of the Golden Dawn's grades: each sphere
labelled with its grade's number and name, with the grade's element,
order and planet below, and linked to the grade's page; the paths are
not linked. Any of `TreeOfLife`'s props override these.

GdHall.description:
A Golden Dawn temple hall as inline SVG (plan 061). Pure and SSR-safe:
layout comes from `resolveHall`, text widths from the generated font
table, and gradient and pattern ids from `useId`, so several halls share
a page. Content is untrusted: strings only reach text nodes, unknown tags
draw as dashed placeholders, and nothing is loaded by URL except the
fonts the caller points at.

props.name: hall
props.description: The compiled `gdHall` node; anything else draws an empty hall.

props.name: art
props.description: Art by kind; the package's original art unless the app composes more.

props.name: className
props.description: The `<svg>`'s class.

props.name: fontBaseUrl
props.description:
Where the hall's WOFF2 subsets are served (such as `/fonts`). When set,
the SVG carries its own `@font-face` rules; otherwise the page must.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the hall's shape when not given.

props.name: style
props.description: The `<svg>`'s style.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the hall's shape when not given.

Lamen.description:
An officer's lamen: the collar's ring, the disc and the officer's glyph,
in a −50…50 box. All of it is drawn for this app, the Keryx's caduceus
and the Sentinel's Eye of Horus from geometry since stage H of plan 061
(they were an SVG Repo icon and a game-icons.net path before), the
adepts' since its second part. Defines no ids, so any number can share
a page.

props.name: officer
props.description:
The officer, in camel case (`hierophant`, `pastHierophant`,
`chiefAdept`; `LAMEN_OFFICERS` lists them). Any other draws a plain
lamen, and an empty one the Hierophant's.

props.name: grade
props.description:
The grade whose lamen to draw, for an officer who wears another in it
(`lamenGrades.ts`: the Portal's Hiereus and Hegemon); otherwise the
Outer Order's, as the ritual role icons always show.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width when not given, as it is square.

props.name: innerCircleStyle
props.description: Style for the disc, the inner circle.

props.name: outerCircleStyle
props.description: Style for the collar's ring, the outer circle.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height when not given, as it is square.

RoseSigil.description:
The rose-cross sigil of a Hebrew text, drawn through the letters' places
on the rose. It renders the letter centres first, on the server too, then
spreads repeated and aligned letters with the optimiser once in the
browser, and draws the path on. A client component: the server-safe
drawing is `RoseSigilImage`.

props.name: sigilText
props.description:
The text to draw. Final forms are drawn as their base letters, and
anything not one of the 22 letters (spaces, points, Latin) is left out.

props.name: animate
props.description: Draws the connecting path on, once the layout is optimised.

props.name: debug
props.description: Draws each letter's circle and the unoptimised path too.

props.name: showRose
props.description: Draws the rose's three rings of letters behind the sigil.

SevenBranchedCandleStick.description:
The Golden Dawn's seven-branched candlestick: a branch for each of the
seven planets, with its symbol, Hebrew name, archangel and letter, set
about a heptagram.

props.name: idPrefix
props.description:
Prefixes the text paths' ids, which are document-wide: two of these
on one page need different prefixes. No hook makes one, because the
image routes render this outside React's renderer for hooks.

TableOfShewbread.description:
The Golden Dawn's Table of Shewbread: the twelve signs of the zodiac on a
circle, with the permutations of the Tetragrammaton and the tribes of
Israel the signs are given.

props.name: idPrefix
props.description:
Prefixes the text paths' ids, which are document-wide: two of these
on one page need different prefixes. No hook makes one, because the
image routes render this outside React's renderer for hooks.

FylfotCross.description: The fylfot cross of the signs and elements, as a table of squares.

props.name: cells
props.description: What each square shows, row by row; the finished cross by default.

props.name: ink
props.description:
The squares' borders, a CSS colour such as a theme's custom property;
black by default.

props.name: onClick
props.type: ((id: string | null, rowIndex: number, colIndex: number, correctId: string) => void)
props.description:
Called with a square's id and place when it is clicked. Without it the
squares take no clicks, so the cross renders as a Server Component.

props.name: showColors
props.description: Colours each arm by its element (default true).

Tablet.description:
An Enochian tablet in a version (`version`, the Golden Dawn's by
default): a Watchtower's sigil above its grid on a 210 × 297 page, or
the Tablet of Union's grid on a page of its own (`tabletViewBox`). The
version's reversed letters are mirrored unless `reversed` is false, and
a Watchtower's second letters drawn small in each square's corner when
`alt` is true. A key the data does not have draws an empty page; a
tablet the version does not have, its page saying so. It is an image
named by `tabletName` (an `aria-label`, which shows no tooltip over the
squares as a `<title>` would) unless `label` is false, as for a tablet
drawn inside a larger drawing that names itself.

props.name: id
props.description:
The tablet, by its key in the data: `earth`, `air`, `water`, `fire` or
`union`.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Draw each square's second letters small in its corner (default
false). Watchtowers only: no source gives the Tablet of Union a
second letter, so its grid has none to draw.

props.name: enochianStyle
props.description: Page font style for the grid letters; omitted renders the Latin transliteration.

props.name: frame
props.description: CSS border for on-page display; server images omit it since CSS boxes are not SVG.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the page's shape when not given.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Squares of a Watchtower's grid to outline, and choose by pointer.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name: the tablet's own (`true`), another, or none.

props.name: reversed
props.description: Mirror the letters the version reverses (default true).

props.name: version
props.description:
One of the data's `TABLET_VERSIONS`; the Golden Dawn's (`gd`) when
absent or unknown.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the page's shape when not given.

Kamea.description:
A planet's kamea in an `<svg>` of its own, square, `size` across (240 by
default), the frame inset a little from the edge. With a `label` it is an
image of that name; without one, decoration.

props.name: planet
props.description:
The planet, by magick-data's id; without one, or with a name that is
not one of the seven, an empty frame.

props.name: children
props.description:
Drawn over the numbers, in the figure's units (centred on 0,0,
`KAMEA_SIDE` across; `kameaGeometry` places the cells): room for a
planet's seal or sigils to come.

props.name: className
props.description: The `<svg>`'s class.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: The numbers' font stack.

props.name: ink
props.description: The frame, the rules and the numbers.

props.name: label
props.description: What the square is, for a screen reader ("Kamea of Saturn").

props.name: paper
props.description: The square's ground.

props.name: size
props.description: The drawing's width and height (CSS pixels for a number).

props.name: style
props.description: The `<svg>`'s style.

PlanetarySpirit.description:
A planetary spirit's seal, centred in a flex box as tall as its container
allows. Every prop but `id` and `aria-hidden` is the box's style.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hides the seal from assistive technology when the text names it.

props.name: id
props.description: The spirit, in lower case; none, or an id with no seal, draws nothing.

Chakras.description:
The seven chakras as coloured circles on a figure's silhouette, from the
root at the base of its spine to the crown at the top of its head.

props.name: active
props.description:
A chakra's id in magick-data (`root`, `sacral`, `solar-plexus`,
`heart`, `throat`, `third-eye`, `crown`): that one is drawn and the
others faded. All are drawn when it is absent or names none of them.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the figure's shape when not given.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the figure's shape when not given.

Moon.description:
Today's moon, drawn as it looks from the viewer's hemisphere.

`latitude` is the viewer's, when known (the app passes the reader's place,
plan 072); the moon is drawn as from the north until it is known to be
south of the equator.

props.name: background
props.description: The widget's background image, a URL, drawn to cover; none if omitted.

props.name: latitude
props.description:
The viewer's latitude in degrees, south negative: south of the
equator, the moon is drawn turned as it is seen from there.

props.name: moonPadding
props.description: CSS padding around the drawing, inside the night sky.

Mercury.description:
Mercury's next or current retrograde, worked out in the browser on today's
date and shown in the reader's own date format, under a picture of the
planet. The page's HTML has a blank line where the dates go.

props.name: background
props.description: The tile's background image, a URL, drawn to cover; none if omitted.

props.name: image
props.description: Mercury's picture, drawn 85 px square and decorative: a URL, or `` props for a responsive one (Next's `getImageProps()` gives them). None if omitted.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the picture, as CSS `padding`.
